upgrades.label: Long Range Darts
upgrades.description: Makes the Dart Monkey shoot further than normal.

upgrades.label: Enhanced Eyesight
upgrades.description: Increase attack range even further and allows Dart Monkey to shoot Camo Bloons.

upgrades.label: Spike-o-pult
upgrades.description: Converts the Dart Monkey into a Spike-o-pult, a powerful tower that hurls a large spiked ball instead of darts. Good range, but slower attack speed. Each ball can pop 18 bloons.

upgrades.label: Juggernaut
upgrades.description: Hurls a giant unstoppable killer spiked ball that can pop lead bloons and excels at crushing ceramic bloons.

upgrades.label: Sharp Shots
upgrades.description: Can pop 1 extra bloon per shot.

upgrades.label: Razor Sharp Shots
upgrades.description: Can pop 2 extra bloons per shot.

upgrades.label: Triple Darts
upgrades.description: Throws 3 darts at a time instead of 1.

upgrades.label: Super Monkey Fan Club
upgrades.description: Super Monkey Fan Club Ability: Converts up to 10 nearby dart monkeys into Super Monkeys for 15 seconds
